_doc: Payments GTV adoption, US. One entry per calendar month from the July 2026 launch. Numerator: POS GTV of credible merchants whose first succeeded+paid+captured Loyverse Payments charge fell on or before the month end. Denominator: POS GTV of every credible merchant that month. Credible = GTV_CONFIDENCE in ('1 - Confirmed by card data', '2 - Plausible'), recomputed on each month's OWN volume and median ticket, which is why these are measured rather than today's judgement carried backwards. A completed month is written once and never rewritten; the open month refreshes each run.
